journey.name: wear remove wallet cancel
journey.description:
Cancelling Remove wallet keeps the wallet: the dialog closes, the balance stays, and after a restart the watch still opens on Balance, not onboarding. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet. Backend: hosted regtest.

actions.action: Note the balance "WatchHomeBalance" reads, then swipe the pager left: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Verify the dialog: the text "Remove wallet?", with ✕ (tag "WatchSettingsRemoveCancel") and ✓ (tag "WatchSettingsRemoveConfirm")
Verify the dialog is gone and the Settings page lists "WatchSettingsRemoveWallet"
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 1 minute
Verify "WatchHomeBalance" reads the balance noted in the first step, and "WatchOnboardingRestore" is not listed
